paragraphs: Co-founded by Maxwell Frank and Tye French, Ridgeline Productions is a full-service production company based in Santa Barbara, California.
With over a decade of experience traveling the globe, we produce, direct, and create authentic brand campaigns and commercial films for startups, major corporations, and agencies alike.
about.emphasis: Every project is tailored. Every frame is intentional.
about.philosophy: We don't just capture moments — we craft stories that move people. Every frame is a choice. Every cut is deliberate. From the peaks of Patagonia to the streets of LA, we bring brands to life through visuals that resonate, inspire, and endure.

services.name: The Creative
services.description: We're not here to simply execute — we're here to collaborate. As creative partners, we help shape the architecture behind the work, guiding brands and agencies from initial brief to fully crafted visuals.

services.name: Production
services.description: We embrace being a focused, agile team. As a direct-to-director field production company, we're involved from concept through delivery — ensuring care, precision, and creative alignment at every stage. Ridgeline is a scalable production partner built to bring ideas to life, supported by a global network of producers, directors, and cinematographers.

services.name: Post Production
services.description: Every project is only as good as the post team behind it. Editing, VFX, animation, sound design, and color grading — handled with precision and artistry.

rabbit-cadence.title: Cadence Kit
rabbit-cadence.description: A high-energy product launch film for rabbit's Cadence Kit, blending cinematic storytelling with sleek product visuals to capture the spirit of movement and rhythm.

hoka-transport.title: Transport GTX
hoka-transport.description: An authentic lifestyle campaign for Hoka's Transport GTX, shot across urban and natural landscapes to showcase the shoe's versatility from city streets to mountain trails.

credits.name: Boo Johnson, Karli Lar Durden, Andrew Garner, Kat Lam

giant-recon.title: Recon+ Taillight
giant-recon.description: A sleek product film for Giant's Recon+ Taillight, combining dramatic night cinematography with precision product shots to highlight safety innovation.

rabbit-highcountry.title: High Country
rabbit-highcountry.description: An immersive brand film following runners into the mountains, capturing the raw beauty and endurance of high-altitude trail running for rabbit.

lexus-gx.title: GX 550
lexus-gx.description: A cinematic automotive spot for the Lexus GX 550, featuring sweeping desert landscapes and dynamic driving sequences with Frieda Pinto.

seek-thermal.title: Reveal Fire Pro
seek-thermal.description: A technical product film showcasing Seek Thermal's Reveal Fire Pro, combining dramatic fire scenarios with precise product demonstrations.

masimo-mightysat.title: MightySat
masimo-mightysat.description: A commercial spot for Masimo's MightySat pulse oximeter, featuring athletes Tommy Hass and Taylor Fritz to demonstrate peak performance monitoring.

hoka-carbon.title: Carbon X2
hoka-carbon.description: A dynamic product film for Hoka's Carbon X2 racing shoe, capturing speed and precision on the track.

wtb-tread.title: Leaving a Tread
wtb-tread.description: A documentary following rider Israel Carrillo on a personal journey through trail and terrain, produced in partnership with WTB and Kona Bicycles.

liv-avow.title: Avow
liv-avow.description: A high-performance commercial for Liv Cycling's Avow triathlon bike, filmed in the velodrome with precision camera work.

wtb-czr.title: CZR Wheels
wtb-czr.description: A product showcase for WTB's CZR wheel line, highlighting engineering and performance through dynamic riding footage.

giant-helmets.title: Helmet Campaign
giant-helmets.description:
This was one of our favorite shoots to date! Giant Bicycles gave us the opportunity to create this commercial for their new Pursuit aero and Rev Pro helmets.

How did we do it? Lots of pre-production and planning. With only a few weeks to plan this entire shoot, which also had other elements beyond this helmet, we worked closely with photographer Jeff Clark and the team at Giant to come up with the concepts and props we needed to make it happen. Lets just say we have become masters with spray paint and building custom wooden boxes/light tables last minute.

giant-shoes.title: Shoe Campaign
giant-shoes.description:
When we were approached by Giant Bicycles to create an ad campaign for a few of their new shoe lineups we were stoked! There were three categories, road, gravel and gravity. We asked ourselves how we would make these videos and images unique.

The recipe:
- Research
- Lots of custom props
- Unique angles
- Two days of shooting on location
- A great team
